# West Virginia, United States Genealogy



[United States](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/United_States_Genealogy "United States Genealogy")

West Virginia

Guide to **West Virginia ancestry, family history, and genealogy** birth records, marriage records, death records, census records, and military records.

## West Virginia Information

West Virginia is a state in the eastern part of the United States. It is divided into 55 counties and its capital is Charleston. West Virginia was admitted to the union as the 35th state on 20 June 1863. It was created from the state of Virginia.[[1]](#cite_note-1) *See [West Virginia History](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/West_Virginia_History "West Virginia History") for more information.*

## West Virginia Clickable Map

Many genealogy records are kept on the county level in the United States. Click on a county below to go to the county Wiki article listing more information.
